waypointsapi.config.title: Waypoints API
waypointsapi.config.category.shown.about: Which waypoints are shown in the world. Distance and count are on Kinds; pins are in the list.
waypointsapi.config.category.look.about: The look shared by every kind.
waypointsapi.config.category.kinds.about: Distance, count and group colors are set on the settings of the mod that adds the kind.
waypointsapi.config.category.maps.about: Whether the installed map mods show the waypoints.
waypointsapi.config.kind_settings.desc: Opens the settings screen of the mod that adds this kind.
waypointsapi.config.kind_settings.none.d: The mod that adds this kind has no settings screen.
waypointsapi.config.show_waypoints.desc: When off, hides all beams, labels and the arrows at the screen's edges. A key can switch it too.
waypointsapi.config.show_beams.desc: A beam of light rises from each waypoint's place, seen through terrain.
waypointsapi.config.show_markers.desc: A diamond in the group's color at the waypoint's height, shown even with the beams off. Waypoints of a heightless kind and of the other dimension get theirs at your eye height.
waypointsapi.config.show_initials.desc: The first letter of the group's name inside each diamond, or a letter the group's mod picked.
waypointsapi.config.show_direction_hud.d: Waypoints out of view get an arrow at the left or right edge of the screen, with how far and which way they are.
waypointsapi.config.nearest_of_each_grou: A group is a part of a kind (for structures, villages or strongholds). When on, only the nearest waypoint of every group is shown, whatever each group's "Only the Nearest" in its mod's settings says.
waypointsapi.config.show_explored.desc: A waypoint you have been near becomes explored, and is not shown. When on, explored ones are shown too. Pinned ones are shown either way.
waypointsapi.config.show_other_dimension: Shows the Overworld's waypoints in the Nether and the Nether's in the Overworld, at the scaled coordinates. Pinned ones are shown either way.
waypointsapi.config.show_labels.desc: A label with the name and more over each waypoint.
waypointsapi.config.max_labels.desc: The nearest this many waypoints always have a label; farther ones only while you look at them.
waypointsapi.config.label_distance.desc: Labels say how far the waypoint is.
waypointsapi.config.label_height.desc: Labels say how far above (↑) or below (↓) you the waypoint is, nothing when you are at its height.
waypointsapi.config.label_coordinates.de: Labels say where the waypoint is. Those of the other dimension's waypoints always do.
waypointsapi.config.map_journeymap.desc: Shows the waypoints on JourneyMap's full map.
waypointsapi.config.map_xaero.desc: Shows the waypoints on Xaero's World Map, when Xaero's Minimap is installed.
waypointsapi.config.map_voxelmap.desc: Lets the waypoint list add waypoints to VoxelMap's.
waypointsapi.config.kind.look_elsewhere: How beams and labels look is set in Waypoints API's settings.
waypointsapi.config.kind.show.desc: Shows this kind's waypoints in the world and on map mods. Pinned ones are shown either way.
waypointsapi.config.kind.distance.desc: How far away (in blocks) this kind's waypoints are shown.
waypointsapi.config.kind.max_shown.desc: How many of this kind's waypoints are shown at most, the nearest first.
waypointsapi.config.group.color.desc: The color of this group's beams, labels and map marks.
waypointsapi.config.group.nearest_only.d: Shows only the nearest of this group's waypoints in the world. The others are still in the list, and shown in the world when pinned.
waypointsapi.list.title: Waypoints
waypointsapi.list.no_kinds: No mod has added waypoints yet.
waypointsapi.list.sort.name: By name
waypointsapi.list.to_map.partly: Added to %s; could not add it to %s.
waypointsapi.teleport.not_allowed: You are not allowed to use /tp here.
